text.name: Title

text.name: Title
text.text: What can you do with REP?

text.name: Summary
text.text: A short section for REP holders: what reporting and challenging can pay, and what they risk.

text.name: Label
text.text: DETAILS

text.name: Text
text.text: Square math: a Paper square is your bond, Green is what you win and a dashed outline is what you lose. Rows instead of tiles, so it doesn’t repeat Who decides.

text.name: Text
text.text: Reporting and challenging are framed as optional, so nothing implies that holding REP is a duty. The fork isn’t mentioned.

text.name: Text
text.text: Payouts follow the whitepaper: an unchallenged report gets its bond back plus part of the query fee (§4.0.2). Winners get 80% of the losing bonds and 20% is burned (§4.3.1), so the copy says “most”.

text.text: Animation (to do): the returned bond slides back and the Green square pops in, once per row as it scrolls into view.

text.name: Title
text.text: Tenet animations

text.name: Summary
text.text: The three diagrams under “With Augur, no party controls the answer.” are animations. They play once as the section scrolls into view, then rest as drawn on Homepage.

text.name: Label
text.text: DETAILS

text.name: Text
text.text: Answer line: rises 18 px and fades in (0–0.6 s).

text.name: Text
text.text: Permissionless: the dotted edge appears and participants pop in; then squares slide in across the edge from all four sides, leaving fading trails, and the Green newcomer arrives last (0.4–2.05 s).

text.name: Text
text.text: Decentralized: squares appear in scattered order and Green links draw between neighbours (0.45–1.6 s). Then a highlight hops across the mesh one square at a time: as one fades out the next fades in, and the link between them glows (six hops, 1.75–6.1 s).

text.name: Text
text.text: Trustless: the squares pop in, solid lines reach from each side toward the empty middle and the dotted gaps appear; then a small square crosses each lane, and the last arrival lights the result Green (0.45–2.85 s).

text.name: Label
text.text: FOR THE BUILD

text.name: Text
text.text: Easing: the site’s reveal curve, cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1); a small overshoot only on the newcomer.

text.name: Text
text.text: Mesh highlight: Green square and 2 px link with a soft Green glow (square 0 0 18 px, spread 2, 60%; link 0 0 6 px, 90%). Base links rest at 45% opacity. Crossfades ease in and out, cubic-bezier(.45, 0, .55, 1).

text.name: Text
text.text: Plays once per visit, nothing loops; with reduced motion the end state shows immediately.
